audit_default.conf:
# --- audit real-PG test cluster (OPS_AUDIT_REAL_PG_PLAN.md) ---
port = 55472
listen_addresses = 'localhost'
max_connections = 30
ssl = on
ssl_cert_file = 'C:/JV_Tools/pg63/tls/server.crt'
ssl_key_file = 'C:/JV_Tools/pg63/tls/server.key'
ssl_min_protocol_version = 'TLSv1.3'
password_encryption = 'scram-sha-256'
log_statement = 'none'
log_min_error_statement = 'panic'
log_connections = on
logging_collector = off
audit_default.hba:
hostssl postgres,jp_vocab_test_audit_ok,jp_vocab_test_audit_bad jpva_admin 127.0.0.1/32 sspi map=pg63 include_realm=1 compat_realm=1
hostssl jp_vocab_test_audit_ok,jp_vocab_test_audit_bad jpva_audit 127.0.0.1/32 scram-sha-256
hostssl postgres,jp_vocab_test_audit_ok,jp_vocab_test_audit_bad jpva_admin ::1/128 sspi map=pg63 include_realm=1 compat_realm=1
hostssl jp_vocab_test_audit_ok,jp_vocab_test_audit_bad jpva_audit ::1/128 scram-sha-256
hostnossl all all 127.0.0.1/32 reject
hostnossl all all ::1/128 reject
host all all 0.0.0.0/0 reject
host all all ::0/0 reject

post_connect: SELECT pg_catalog.host(pg_catalog.inet_server_addr()) AS server_addr, pg_catalog.inet_server_port() AS server_port, pg_catalog.current_setting('server_version_num') AS version, pg_catalog.current_database()::pg_catalog.text AS dbname, (SELECT d.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_database AS d  WHERE d.datname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) pg_catalog.current_database()) AS db_oid, (SELECT r.oid FROM pg_catalog.pg_roles AS r  WHERE r.rolname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) CURRENT_USER) AS role_oid, (SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(c.oid ORDER BY c.relname) FROM pg_catalog.pg_class AS c  JOIN pg_catalog.pg_namespace AS n ON n.oid OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) c.relnamespace  WHERE n.nspname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) 'public'  AND c.relname OPERATOR(pg_catalog.=) ANY (%s)) AS object_oids, (SELECT pg_catalog.array_agg(identity_value) FROM jp_vocab_ops_synthetic.db_identity) AS identity

apply: GRANT USAGE ON SEQUENCE public.srs_migration_runs_id_seq TO "jpvm_write"
